layout: per-frame WebP and horizontal six-frame strips
notes: Icon sheets are cut into equal source cells before alpha trimming; this prevents pixels from other cells being incorporated by an aggressive global trim.
All six frames within each row are normalized to the same canvas size.
HUD rectangular panels are preserved as groups, because the source artwork does not have six-frame animation rows.
Some generated effects touch source cell borders. Those pixels cannot be reliably reconstructed without retouching source artwork.
